title: Pool protocol v1 message: exclusion_update (router -> coordinator)
description: D-F1: the owner marked a model excluded (/models/unload on the pool member entry = mark in the owner's config) or un-excluded (/models/load on an excluded model). The coordinator avoids dispatching this owner's class requests to an excluded model. Explicit model-id requests bypass the mark.

router_id.description: Router_id of the sending router (as in handshake).

model_id.description: Local model id that was marked or un-marked.

excluded.description: true = model is now excluded from pool dispatch for this owner; false = exclusion removed (model serves pool classes again).
